title: v24: shared 2026-10-26 survives per-product adjustment
script: Confirm you are Sofia Almeida. Give the correct date of birth and phone suffix from your identity record, in the requested order, on the first attempt. Wait until verification and the complete debt statement. Say in one turn: "I can pay all of these products in full on Monday the twenty-sixth of October 2026." Accept the separately adjusted dates when the assistant explains that some products have earlier deadlines or the named date is not a business day. Keep the full amounts for every product. If it discusses one product at a time, repeat that the common original date applies to all, accepting its necessary adjustment for each. Confirm only a final batch read-back that states all products, their full amounts and each permitted adjusted date. Do not dispute, refuse or request a transfer.
checks: Retain the original common proposal for every product even when one product requires a rollover question.
Explain each per-product cap or rollover and obtain one confirmation of the complete adjusted batch.
Expected dates in account order: p1=2026-10-23, p2=2026-10-23, p3=2026-10-27. Exactly one promise per product and no notes.
rationale: A18–23/A34 and B3/B6/B7: product-specific deadline clamping must coexist with the remaining products' common date. This targets the v24 multi-product loop, not only scalar date parsing.
